design_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / CYBERPUNK HUD TERMINAL
emotional_tone: Institutional quantitative precision meets high-speed cyberpunk telemetry. Ruthless information density, laser-sharp contrast, tactical HUD overlays, and futuristic probability physics.

entry_surfaces./: Branded split hero terminal — Left: quantum market ticker, live telemetry metrics, instant launch CTA; Right: seeded live multi-asset orderbook & Monte Carlo forecast preview banner with live neon sparklines
entry_surfaces./login: Branded HUD access console — Left: tactical system status, active membership tiers matrix, real-time latency ping; Right: secure terminal key authentication form with biometric/instant demo bypass
entry_surfaces./register: Branded tactical onboarding station — Left: Tier breakdown & paper seed allocation preview ($100k testnet fund); Right: credentials registration & trader alias generator

layout_and_grids.philosophy: Tactical HUD Grid with 1px border frames, corner bracket accents, and zero dead space. High scanability with responsive subgrids.
layout_and_grids.global_shell: Sticky Tactical Header (Height: 64px, Glassmorphism with bottom border #1E293B) + Top Market Telemetry Ticker Marquee + Main Stage (Dynamic Bento) + Bottom Status Dock / Keyboard shortcuts bar

grid_modes.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 lg:p-6

visual_enhancers.hud_corners: Relative container with corner brackets (::before and ::after borders in cyan/slate)
visual_enhancers.scanline_effect: Subtle repeating linear gradient 1px dark overlay on chart viewports (opacity 0.03)

nasdaq_and_crypto_directory.description: Comprehensive searchable/filterable directory containing all NASDAQ listings (~3000+ equities) and Top 100 Cryptocurrencies by market cap.
nasdaq_and_crypto_directory.ui_pattern: Virtual/paginated high-speed data grid with quick tabs ('All', 'NASDAQ Equities', 'Top 100 Crypto', 'Gainers', 'DeFi/AI Catalysts', 'Watchlist'). Real-time search by symbol & name, sector pills, market cap sorting, 24h delta sparklines, and single-click 'PREDICT' or 'TRADE' buttons with data-testid attributes.
nasdaq_and_crypto_directory.european_locale_support: Clean number formats with proper decimal separators and standard ISO dates.

advanced_futuristic_prediction_system.description: Flagship predictive intelligence view opened when clicking any symbol or requesting AI forecast.

components.cone_chart: Recharts ComposedChart / Area + Line rendering Monte Carlo Simulation fan. Historical candle/line path connecting directly into future projection zone.
components.support_and_resistance_rails: Horizontal dashed tactical beam lines with price tags (R2, R1, PIVOT, S1, S2) and touch count frequency indicators.
components.confidence_corridor: Area gradient filled with #00F0FF at 8% opacity representing the 1-sigma to 2-sigma probability distribution band.

telemetry_gauges.win_probability_bar: Segmented 0-100% horizontal neon bar with Bull/Bear win-rate ratio (e.g. 68.4% Bullish Probability)
telemetry_gauges.volatility_score: Implied Volatility gauge with percentile rank
telemetry_gauges.var_risk_metric: Value at Risk (95% 1-Day VaR) numerical readout
telemetry_gauges.catalyst_summary: AI generated bullet synopsis of technical indicators (RSI divergence, MACD histogram shift, orderbook imbalance)

deposit_and_investment_flows.simulated_paper_deposit: Instant testnet liquidity faucet ($1,000 to $100,000 instant credit to buying power with telemetry confirmation).
deposit_and_investment_flows.membership_and_crypto_checkout: 10-Tier Membership matrix ($9/mo to $999/mo Quantum VIP) with direct Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and USDT test payments, plus simulated Stripe card checkout.
deposit_and_investment_flows.order_execution: Instant Market / Limit / Stop-Loss order ticket with slippage simulator, leverage slider (1x - 50x), position size calculator, and real-time PnL tracker.

guidelines.stagger_children: Stagger container items by 0.04s for data tables and metric cards
guidelines.button_hover: Hover scale 1.02 with neon border transition and subtle glow increase (duration: 0.15s ease)
guidelines.chart_draw: Line animations on mount with duration 0.8s easeOut for prediction projection paths
guidelines.modal_entrance: Scale from 0.96 to 1.0, opacity from 0 to 1 with slight spring physics (damping: 24, stiffness: 300)

accessibility_and_contrast.apca_standards: All text and interactive widgets strictly adhere to WCAG AA / APCA standards. Deep dark background #07090E pairs with #F8FAFC and #94A3B8 ensuring > 7.5:1 contrast ratio.
accessibility_and_contrast.colorblind_safety: Bull and Bear indicators always pair chromatic color (green/red) with directional arrows (▲ / ▼), numerical prefix (+ / -), and explicit text labels ('BULLISH' / 'BEARISH').
accessibility_and_contrast.data_testids: All buttons, inputs, tabs, search bars, prediction triggers, deposit buttons, and trade submit elements MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid tags (e.g., data-testid='symbol-search-input', data-testid='predict-btn-AAPL', data-testid='timeframe-1w-tab', data-testid='deposit-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the established dark cyberpunk HUD aesthetic — upgrade features systematically without breaking existing routes.

Implement comprehensive seed and simulated datasets for NASDAQ equities (AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META, AMD, NFLX, INTC, + hundreds dynamically searchable) and Top 100 Crypto assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, NEAR, SUI, etc.).

The futuristic prediction chart MUST be a rich visual centerpiece: render actual Monte Carlo fan pathways, support (S1, S2) and resistance (R1, R2) dynamic levels, probability win-rate gauges, and 1D / 1W / 1M timeframe toggles.
Provide a robust Paper Trading and Deposit modal that allows simulated cash deposits ($5k, $10k, $50k, custom) as well as Bitcoin/Crypto test checkout for the 10-tier membership plan.
Ensure every interactive element has kebab-case data-testid attributes for thorough Playwright testing.
Use Base-UI and Shadcn primitives customized to cyberpunk HUD styles with sharp 1px borders, muted cyan glows, and JetBrains Mono numerical displays.
